manifesto.title: The Blueprint Meets The Steel
manifesto.subtitle: A sovereign discovery network for the Moroccan innovation ecosystem

sections.heading: The Vision
sections.body: ScaleTrek is not a social network. It is a sovereign discovery bridge — an elite, asset-light matching matrix designed to reconnect the Moroccan entrepreneurial ecosystem with its true potential. We exist to solve one fundamental problem: the trust gap between those who build and those who fuel.

sections.heading: The Blueprint & The Steel
sections.body: Every great structure requires both a blueprint and steel. The Dreamer Stream honors the visionary architects — the ones who draw the plans for industries that do not yet exist. The Reality Check Stream celebrates the builders — the restaurants, logistics operators, and manufacturers who have already sunk steel into the ground and need capital to scale. ScaleTrek gives equal reverence to both. One cannot exist without the other.

sections.heading: The Switchboard, Not The Bank
sections.body: We do not handle money. We do not touch escrow. We do not take a percentage of your deal. ScaleTrek is a pure matching engine: we surface high-signal opportunities, verify the data, and step aside. The legal contract, the capital transfer, and the notary meeting happen entirely offline. This insulates us from heavy financial regulation while keeping the focus where it belongs — on the quality of the connection.

sections.heading: Trust, Programmatically
sections.body: On ScaleTrek, trust is not declared — it is demonstrated. Our Momentum Engine tracks execution consistency, milestone fulfillment, and update frequency. Every profile carries a living, breathing score that naturally decays with inactivity. There are no likes, no follower counts, no vanity metrics. Only signal.

sections.heading: Morocco First
sections.body: We are built for Morocco, by a team that understands its contours. From the souk merchants of Marrakech to the deep-tech labs of Technopark, ScaleTrek is designed to surface opportunity across the full spectrum of the national economy. Arabic and French are first-class citizens. The architecture respects local regulatory realities. The ambition is global, but the foundation is unapologetically Moroccan.

legal.intro: By using ScaleTrek, you agree to these terms. ScaleTrek is a discovery matching platform — we do not handle funds, execute trades, or facilitate financial transactions.
legal.noLiability: ScaleTrek provides a matching service only. All investment decisions, due diligence, legal contracts, and capital transfers occur entirely off-platform. We are not liable for any financial losses, disputes, or outcomes arising from connections made through the platform.
legal.userResponsibility: Users are responsible for verifying the accuracy of their own profile information, conducting independent due diligence on any counterparty, and complying with all applicable Moroccan laws and regulations.
legal.dataUsage: We collect profile information, usage data, and communication metadata to operate and improve the platform. We do not sell personal data. Data is stored securely on Supabase infrastructure.
legal.contact: For questions about these terms, contact support@scaletrek.app
